## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so reminders are not sent to customers who have already paid. The per-resource router split remains paused/superseded. Enterprise tenant onboarding is paused after completing step 5; resume with step 6.

## Recent work
Validated timezone support for `America/New_York`, added scheduler recurrence regression coverage for post-DST wall time, and confirmed `tests/test_scheduler.py` plus `tests/test_billing.py` pass (31 tests). Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

The full suite reached 186 passed, 2 skipped, and one unrelated failure: `tests/test_invoices.py::test_rounding_legacy_currency` expected 1000 but received 1001. This prompted additional investigation of `billing/currency.py`: `round_money` uses Decimal quantization with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Added `tests/test_currency_rounding.py` covering half-cent, negative, zero, small, default-precision, and high-precision cases; all 6 pass, with 91% coverage for `billing.currency`. No currency implementation change was made, and the invoice test was left for separate review.

Onboarding successfully created and migrated `org_acme_industries`, seeded enterprise data, and ensured billing customer `cus_acme_2025`.

For the active dunning defect, use sandbox payment base URL `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`, not `sbx-pay-a`. Do not increase the SQLAlchemy pool above its current size, and do not manually edit license text or attribution in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

Continue splitting `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers, keeping commits small. Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` proves at least 400 successful executions/sec with zero timeout failures.

Separately pending: execute the `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` procedure for Acme Industries in the specified order, one command at a time.

## Recent work
Billing now accepts an injected session; all 26 billing tests pass. Replaced repository wildcard model imports, fixed invoice pagination, and removed Ruff `B008` findings with `Annotated` dependencies. Final checks passed: Ruff clean and full suite 149 passed, 2 skipped.

Replaced a direct invoice-ID `print()` in `ledgerly/api/routes.py` with structured logging using `logger.info("invoice_created", extra={"invoice_id": invoice.id})`; all 11 invoice API tests passed. Added a request-ID field extractor in `ledgerly/logging.py`, safely reading the `current_request_id` context variable. The imported `RequestContextMiddleware` may still be unused pending integration/verification. Sandbox payments base URL is `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev`.

Fix the dunning email scheduler in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`, which sends reminders to customers who have already paid. The per-resource router split is paused/superseded. The `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` procedure is also paused after validation step 1.

Added request IDs to structured logging and safely handled missing request context; logging tests and health tests pass. Replaced a payment exception print with structured logging; payment tests pass. Added a settings-loaded debug log containing only the setting count and source path.

Investigated and fixed recurring scheduler DST behavior by timezone-aware datetime combination; scheduler tests pass, including a new midnight-transition test. Full suite previously had 142 passed, 3 skipped, and one health-log assertion failure, which was fixed and its 4 tests passed.

The dunning scheduler issue is the current unresolved defect. Sandbox payment base URL is now `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; do not use `sbx-pay-a`.
